speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That was the stair. I heard no cat and no tune. You may now go through this door, which is the one that leads to a road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going through it. There is a book on the sill, and I want the day off it before the road has me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The almanac is a penny's worth of other people's weather. If it has an hour in it, say the hour. If it has not, do not stand there inventing one while I hold a cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not opened it. I am opening it. You can hate the pause. You cannot have the line before I have read it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The board is clear. I am not in this quarrel. The fire is banked for a man who said he would be back when the loaf was cut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be back when it is cut. This is a look, not a second breakfast.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A look is a thing that ends. Turn the leaf, or shut it. The close is light enough to walk in, and Shoreditch is not in the close.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One leaf. The one with today on it. Then I am yours to send, and I will not argue the sending.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Today, then. And no sermon out of a printed moon. I have heard enough sermons out of less.
